decisionLog.decision: Redesign the compaction re-prime vehicle (user decision, Oct 3): inject the restoration as a service synthetic message (POST /api/session/{id}/synthetic, resume:false) instead of rewriting the user prompt; prompts and queued follow-ups pass verbatim; the marker-bearing synthetic counts as compensation in the transcript rule, closing the queue-blindness loop. Supersedes this change's original piggyback design; builds on 2026-10-02-s4p21's stateless detection. Also: usage panel ceiling switches to model.Limit.Input (fallback Context) per measured service compaction behavior (~88-91% of input limit).
